newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: SFE floor trading open for Australia budget night.
newsitem.headline: SFE floor trading open for Australia budget night.

text.p: The Sydney Futures Exchange (SFE) trading floor will be open for the Australian government's 1997/98 budget on May 13 between 7.00 p.m. and 8.15 p.m. (0900-1015 GMT).
Budget night is the only evening each year the SFE operates its trading floor and is historically one of the busiest trading sessions of the year, said Les Hosking, the SFE's Chief executive.
Following the close of this special trading session, the SFE's overnight screen dealing system SYCOM would commence trading at 8.30 p.m. and continue to 6.00 a.m. (1030 to 2000 GMT).
